questions.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(8) & =P(X\le 8) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,8\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2,3,4\})+P(X\in \{5,6,7,8\}) \\  & =P(X\le 4)+P(5\le X\le 8) \\  & =F(4)+P(5\le X\le 8).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(5\le X\le 8) & =F(8)-F(4) \\  & =0.9106-0.3895 \\  & =0.5211.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

$$
P(X>a)=1-P(X\le a)=1-F(a).
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X>7) & =1-P(X\le 7) \\  & =1-F(7) \\  & =1-0.9934 \\  & =0.0066.\end{aligned}
$$
